description: Mint a temporary download URL for one file in a KNMI Data Platform dataset. Returns the signed URL, the content type, the byte size and when the file was last modified. The URL is short-lived and must be used promptly. Pass a filename from knmi_dataset_files, e.g. dataset "radar_reflectivity_composites" version "2.0" filename "RAD_NL25_PCP_NA_202609172205.h5". Note the files are scientific binaries (NetCDF, HDF5, GRIB in tar) — this hands back a link to fetch, it does not decode them.
name: knmi_file_url
title: Knmi File Url
